titles: CHAPTER NINE. On Sacred Scripture's parts
Internal criterion of the thing: inspiration; prophetic holiness and infallibility in writing
Prophetic divinity; criterion of the sign (Hebrew and Greek); external catholic testimony
Inferences 1-2: canonical authority for each listed book; one unchanging canon reason
Inferences 3-4: canons judge controversies; adequate sufficiency against unwritten word
Aph. II-IV: Old Testament canonical books; historical, poetic, prophetic; Pentateuch, Triteuch, Octateuch
Aph. V-VIII: contents of Pentateuch, Triteuch, Octateuch; poetic books
Aph. IX-XII: prophetic books; major and minor prophets
Aph. XIII-XV: Apocrypha defined; historical and didactic Apocrypha
Aph. XVI-XVIII: New Testament canonical books; four integral parts; evangelical part
Aph. XIX-XXII: practical part (Acts); epistolary part; Paul's fourteen letters
Aph. XXIII: Apocalyptic part; Cap. 9 close
